STRATEGIC SHIFT confirmed with Anthony, 2026-05-16. Golden Lattice transitions from research apparatus to daily driver. Anchor: Golden Lattice is a daily driver for Anthony's real decisions; every real session auto-falsifies on all three ARCHITECTURE.md criteria (parity, insight-preservation, preference) and feeds a living cross-session evidence base; using it for real is the empirical hardening. The level-up is collapsing the split between using the Lattice and gathering evidence on it: daily real use generates the parity history, insight-preservation data, and preference data as byproduct, so utility and rigor become the same activity.

Context this follows: Option A landed (compute_parity_shares wired into orchestrator as canonical Session-builder), H1 confirmed (wiring was the whole bug, H2 structurally inexpressible at N=3), 276 tests green, ARCHITECTURE.md falsification criterion #3 satisfied on real emo-lang code review session_20260505_010010_e9fd466c with divergent-strength distribution all >0.15 (Sonnet leads edge cases, Opus leads distinct claims + structural patterns, Haiku present on every dimension, vestigial on none). Premise earned on real work.

Milestone ladder, ordered: M0 (now, one command) store.parity_history() over the four May 4 sessions, chronicle as first evidence batch on criterion #3. M1 live TUI, three columns, parity panel reads session.metrics only. M2 frictionless invocation (lattice "question" from anywhere, no prompt-file dance). M3 criteria #1 and #2 harness (preference + insight-preservation measured per session like parity is). M4 cross-session evidence surface (aggregate parity/insight history rendered, drift-flagging live; also four-artifacts artifact A maturing).

The standing real-prompt gate is DISSOLVED into the goal: no special first prompt, the first real run is the next real decision Anthony brings, fired through M1's TUI. HQ follow-ons fold in: backfill = M0, userspace cleanup (run_code_session.py:166-186 redundant recompute) = separate atomic commit alongside M1, schema-refusal (N=3 and metrics=None) stays Anthony's spec-amendment call, off critical path.

Provenance: web-chat seat claude-opus-4-7 session spiral_20260502_225324 drafted the goal shape across the May 16 conversation; Anthony confirmed 'love it'; T2Helix set_goal to be fired HQ-side (T2Helix not loaded on web-chat seat; goal anchor lives in T2Helix, strategic framing lives here in Sovereign Stack; the two chronicles stay separate per architecture). T2Helix observed working to great effect this session (chronicle write id 403 came through t2helix record MCP).
